items.title: What To Know If You're Buying an Xbox for GTA VI Fix
items.description: Grand Theft Auto 6 is right around the corner and if you’ve been waiting to upgrade to the next generation of Xbox, now is the time. After a lot of changes behind the scenes at Microsoft since the launch of the Xbox Series S and Series X, there is so much to sort through before picking up a new console in 2026. Here is everything you need to know about this generation on Xbox, Game Pass, and how to best enjoy Grand Theft Auto 6 on your new Xbox Series console.
